tick_convention: A record seeded at x0 moving one Link per tick is resident at x0 + t after tick t. Records that become co-resident at tick T interact in the local cycle of tick T; converted moving outputs appear as `sent` events at tick T with arrival_tick T + 1. A record sent from the last Node of an open axis at tick T is recorded as `escaped` at tick T + 1.

contract: family-conversion-n-to-m-v1: every rule declares participants (N inputs, 1..6) and outputs (M output families, 1..6); all outputs are assigned from one frozen snapshot; conserved fields and per-record readout invariants are summed over all N inputs and all M outputs before one commit; outputs beyond N take free slots or the rule fails before commit; every product of a conversion leaves on a distinct Port or the rule fails before commit; non-participant records keep ordinary transport (several packets per Port)
catalog_bindings: bindings.json records the catalog entity ids (electron, positron, photon), the encoded charge (thirds) and rest energy (keV/c2 to the nearest unit, c = 1) and the interaction family of each rule: pair_creation_annihilation for annihilation, pair production and the three-photon candidate; electromagnetic_scattering (compton_scattering) for the Compton-like exchange
